title: Skulls candle totem
description: Totem candle with a skull animation of a light
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d922dfc78a024cdfdba6ecfb8f809e0c5a6465fe.png)
##
This resource pack modifies the totem by making a skull with a candle out of it. This candle has a light. Occasionally, an effect with the inscription "Die" appears from the light.
This resource pack is suitable for everyone who loves this style.
